questions.question: What impact did railways and automobiles have on the hotel industry? / [CO1]

  • Ans.
  • Increased Travel: Railways and automobiles made travel more accessible and affordable,
  • expanding the guest pool for hotels.
  • Boosted Regional Tourism: With better transportation options, tourists could easily reach
  • different regions, increasing demand for hotels in both urban and rural areas.
  • Growth of Hotel Chains: The rise in travel led to the expansion of hotel chains, creating
  • standardized lodging options for travellers.
  • Longer Stays : Travelers could now reach destinations faster, leading to longer stays and more
  • bookings at hotels.
  • New Market Segments: Railways and automobiles created opportunities for hotels to cater to
  • different market segments, such as road trippers, business travellers, and tourists.
